The Challenge

Education Today Online, a leading portal for insightful education articles and expert opinions, sought a website refresh. 

Their goal? To create a platform that reflected their brand values and vast resource library while simultaneously improving user experience and engagement. The key challenges were:

  • Brand Alignment: The existing website did not fully reflect Education Today Online’s established brand identity.
  • Speed Optimization: A vast library of valuable documents caused slow loading times, hindering user experience.
  • Boosting Engagement: Increasing user interaction and time spent on the site for a more engaging learning experience.
  • Monetization: Integrating a sustainable revenue generation model to support the platform’s growth.

The Solution

We approached these multifaceted challenges with a systematic plan. Recognizing the need for brand alignment, we proposed a website redesign that mirrored Education Today Online’s unique brand identity and the informative, engaging content it provides. To enhance user engagement, we opted for mini-games, fostering interaction while upholding the brand’s informative tone. To generate revenue, we planned to incorporate advertisement spaces, boosting website visibility while creating an income stream. Finally, to improve website speed and reduce bounce rates, we prioritized website optimization by eliminating unnecessary elements that impeded loading times.

The Creative Process

The transformation began with a complete website redesign. We ensured visual and content cohesion with Education Today Online’s brand identity, creating a more user-friendly experience.

Next, we introduced four engaging mini-quizzes, transforming the website into a more interactive and enjoyable platform for users. These quizzes tested knowledge, provided immediate feedback, and encouraged further exploration of the website’s extensive resources. 

A dedicated ad placement area was created, allowing the brand to integrate advertisements that generated revenue opportunities while remaining relevant to the website’s audience.

A critical challenge involved integrating the sub-brand, Education Today Journal’s vast content library, while maintaining website speed. We addressed this challenge by streamlining website plug-ins, ensuring all journals remained readily accessible, enhancing overall security, and minimizing vulnerability to threats while significantly improving website speed.

This strategic website revamp empowered Education Today Online to provide a user-centric platform that fosters engagement, brand identity, and revenue generation. 

The result? A transformed website that serves as a hub for modern, interactive learning, empowering users to explore a world of knowledge in a dynamic and engaging way.

The Challenge

Galeno, a leading hygiene solutions provider in the UAE, sought to refresh its website and refine its brand identity while retaining its existing logo and core brand message. Their primary concern was the website’s cumbersome checkout process and the lack of secure payment options. With a decade of B2B expertise, Galeno desired to seamlessly expand into the B2C space by enhancing user experience while shopping via their website.

The Creative Process

Branding

The existing logo was retained, as per the client’s request, recognizing Galeno’s established brand identity with its ten-year industry presence. To support this identity and cultivate a cohesive brand voice and messaging across all platforms, we developed a comprehensive brand kit. This kit included a defined set of fonts for consistent use in all brand collaterals, strengthening brand recognition and product communication. We also designed social media templates with captivating visuals to elevate Galeno’s social media marketing efforts.

The revised approach ensured a seamless user experience for customers while maintaining brand consistency across all touchpoints. With a secure and user-friendly website, coupled with a refreshed brand identity, Galeno was well-positioned to expand its reach and solidify its position in the UAE’s hygiene solutions market.

Website Revamp

Our focus was to create a more efficient and secure user experience for online shopping.  We began by crafting wireframes, offering Galeno a transparent view of the proposed website’s layout and functionality. Next, we designed and developed the website, addressing any factors hindering its optimal performance. To further enhance the user experience, we elevated the quality of product images and integrated various payment methods, streamlining the checkout process.

The Solution

To address the website and branding challenges, we implemented a multi-step approach, ensuring a smooth and efficient process. First, we conducted a thorough assessment to identify key pain points. Next, working closely with the Galeno team, we designed the website using a user-centric approach. This approach ensured a seamless and optimized experience for online transactions, prioritizing user experience while developing efficient and visually appealing website designs – all within a defined timeframe.

The Challenge

Travel Memories, a travel agency, approached us to rebrand their logo and brand identity to establish themselves as a trusted and reliable travel partner. The challenge was to create a logo and brand identity that captured the brand values and resonated with their target audience. The objective was to cut through the competitive travel and tourism market and create a memorable brand image.

The Solution

Through in-depth conversations with Travel Memories, we gained a thorough insight into their core values and aspirations. We then created a new logo and brand identity that reflected these values and conveyed a sense of trust, safety and reliability to the customers. We carefully selected the brand colours and font styles, ensuring that each aspect reinforced the message of Travel Memories being a dependable travel companion. This rebranding aimed to position Travel Memories as the preferred choice for travellers seeking unforgettable travel experiences.

The Creative Process

Logo

The new logo mark that we designed is a flat logo design which includes two main elements:

  • The location pin: It represents the many travel destinations customers can explore with Travel Memories.
  • The negative space in the shape of an aeroplane: It highlights the brand’s focus on making travel easy and accessible. 

We used the golden ratio to make the logo visually striking and memorable. These elements combine to create a logo that seamlessly reflects the brand’s values and resonates with its target audience.

Colours

Travel Memories is a company with a modern and fresh aesthetic. To portray this personality and the brand values through the brand colours, we decided to use green and blue. The particular shade of green used here adds a sense of modernity and energy, while the blue reinforces the brand’s commitment to safety and trust.

We also designed the use case, from business cards to tote bags, to show the multiple ways for Travel Memories as a brand to become recognizable using the brand’s collateral.
